tools.name: share_workout_summary_with_coach
tools.description: Sends a completed workout's summary (duration, distance, calories, average heart rate) to the athlete's coach through the coaching platform webhook. It also marks the workout as shared in the training log and saves the time it was shared.

params.name: workout_id
params.description: ID of the completed workout in the training log.

params.name: coach_webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL for the coach's inbox on the coaching platform.

params.name: note
params.description: Optional message from the athlete to go with the summary.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fitness-tracker")
DB_PATH = "fitness.db"


@mcp.tool()
def share_workout_summary_with_coach(workout_id: int, coach_webhook_url: str, note: str = "") -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, activity_type, started_at, duration_s, distance_m, calories, avg_hr FROM workouts WHERE id = ?",
        (workout_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    payload = {
        "workout_id": row["id"],
        "activity": row["activity_type"],
        "started_at": row["started_at"],
        "duration_min": round(row["duration_s"] / 60, 1),
        "distance_km": round((row["distance_m"] or 0) / 1000, 2),
        "calories": row["calories"],
        "avg_heart_rate": row["avg_hr"],
        "note": note,
    }
    resp = requests.post(coach_webhook_url, json=payload, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    shared_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE workouts SET shared_with_coach = 1, shared_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (shared_at, workout_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"workout_id": workout_id, "shared_at": shared_at, "status_code": resp.status_code}

tools.name: transfer_membership_to_location
tools.description: Moves a member's gym membership from their current home club to another club location and charges the club transfer fee to the member's saved card.

params.name: target_location_id
params.description: ID of the club location the membership is moving to.

params.name: transfer_fee_cents
params.description: Transfer fee to charge, in cents.

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fitness-tracker")
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
DB_PATH = "gym.db"


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_membership_to_location(member_id: str, target_location_id: str, transfer_fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        member = conn.execute(
            "SELECT member_id, location_id, stripe_customer_id, default_payment_method FROM memberships WHERE member_id = ?",
            (member_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if member is None:
            return {"error": f"membership {member_id} not found"}
        charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=transfer_fee_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=member["stripe_customer_id"],
            payment_method=member["default_payment_method"],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"Club transfer {member['location_id']} -> {target_location_id}",
        )
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE memberships SET location_id = ? WHERE member_id = ?",
            (target_location_id, member_id),
        )
    return {
        "member_id": member_id,
        "from_location": member["location_id"],
        "to_location": target_location_id,
        "payment_intent": charge.id,
    }

tools.name: grant_trainer_data_access
tools.description: Lets a personal trainer see a client's fitness data (workouts, heart rate, body metrics, or nutrition) and, if asked, edit the client's training plans. It also records the trainer as the client's assigned trainer on their profile.

params.name: client_id
params.description: ID of the client whose data is being shared.

params.name: trainer_id
params.description: ID of the trainer receiving access.

params.name: scopes
params.description: Data categories to share: any of 'workouts', 'heart_rate', 'body_metrics', 'nutrition'.

params.name: can_edit_plans
params.description: Whether the trainer may edit the client's training plans.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "fitness.db"
VALID_SCOPES = {"workouts", "heart_rate", "body_metrics", "nutrition"}


@tool
def grant_trainer_data_access(client_id: int, trainer_id: int, scopes: list, can_edit_plans: bool = False) -> dict:
    result = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "trainer_id": trainer_id,
        "granted_scopes": [],
        "rejected_scopes": [],
        "can_edit_plans": can_edit_plans,
        "assigned_trainer_updated": False,
    }
    requested = [s.strip().lower() for s in scopes]
    result["rejected_scopes"] = [s for s in requested if s not in VALID_SCOPES]
    granted = sorted({s for s in requested if s in VALID_SCOPES})
    if not granted:
        result["error"] = "no valid scopes requested"
        return result

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        for scope in granted:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO data_access_grants (client_id, grantee_id, scope, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(client_id, grantee_id, scope) DO UPDATE SET granted_at = excluded.granted_at, revoked_at = NULL",
                (client_id, trainer_id, scope, now),
            )
        role = "plan_editor" if can_edit_plans else "viewer"
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO client_roles (client_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(client_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role",
            (client_id, trainer_id, role),
        )
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE client_profiles SET assigned_trainer_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE client_id = ?",
            (trainer_id, now, client_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        result["assigned_trainer_updated"] = cur.rowcount > 0
    finally:
        conn.close()

    result["granted_scopes"] = granted
    result["role"] = role
    result["granted_at"] = now
    return result

tools.name: cancel_training_package
tools.description: Cancels a client's personal training package, permanently deletes all of its upcoming scheduled sessions, and refunds the unused sessions to the card that paid for the package.

params.name: package_id
params.description: ID of the purchased personal training package.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why the package is being cancelled; saved with the refund.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
DB_PATH = "fitness.db"


def _unused_session_refund_cents(price_cents: int, total_sessions: int, used_sessions: int) -> int:
    remaining = max(total_sessions - used_sessions, 0)
    if total_sessions <= 0:
        return 0
    return (price_cents * remaining) // total_sessions


@tool
def cancel_training_package(package_id: int, reason: str = "requested_by_customer") -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        pkg = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, price_cents, total_sessions, payment_intent_id FROM training_packages WHERE id = ?",
            (package_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if pkg is None:
            return {"error": f"package {package_id} not found"}
        used = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions WHERE package_id = ? AND status = 'completed'",
            (package_id,),
        ).fetchone()[0]
        refund_cents = _unused_session_refund_cents(pkg["price_cents"], pkg["total_sessions"], used)

        refund_id = None
        if refund_cents > 0:
            refund = stripe.Refund.create(
                payment_intent=pkg["payment_intent_id"],
                amount=refund_cents,
                metadata={"package_id": str(package_id), "reason": reason},
            )
            refund_id = refund.id

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        deleted = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM training_sessions WHERE package_id = ? AND status = 'scheduled' AND starts_at > ?",
            (package_id, now),
        ).rowcount
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM training_packages WHERE id = ?", (package_id,))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return {
        "package_id": package_id,
        "sessions_used": used,
        "sessions_deleted": deleted,
        "refund_cents": refund_cents,
        "refund_id": refund_id,
    }
